autoDetect.name: Auto-Detect Best Settings
autoDetect.description: Tests the client and the game on your PC for about two minutes and picks what runs best. Don't touch mouse or keyboard meanwhile. You can undo it

autoDetectResult.name: Last Auto-Detect Result
autoDetectResult.description: See what the last run measured and changed, and undo it

hotkeys.name: Hotkeys
hotkeys.description: Change or clear Kute's own keys (new lobby, matchmaker, reload, fullscreen) and add keys for toggles

performanceMode.name: Disable All Non-Performance Features
performanceMode.description: Turns off everything cosmetic and hides its settings. Turn this off again and all of them come back as they were

startMode.name: Start Mode
startMode.description: How the window opens when Kute starts

gameFpsLimit.name: FPS Limit
gameFpsLimit.description: Caps your FPS to save power and heat. 0 means unlimited

discordRPC.name: Discord Rich Presence
discordRPC.description: Shows your current mode and map on your Discord profile

accountManager.name: Account Manager
accountManager.description: Save your Krunker accounts and switch between them from the menu

obsCapturePlugin.name: OBS Capture Plugin
obsCapturePlugin.description: Adds a Kute Capture source to OBS (close OBS first). For sound, add an Application Audio Capture of 'Kute audio window'

rawInput.name: Raw Input
rawInput.description: Mouse movement comes straight from the device, without Windows pointer acceleration, and all of it reaches the game, also when you click or scroll mid-flick. Krunker's own Raw Mouse Input follows this setting

rampBoost.name: Ramp Boosting
rampBoost.description: Scrolling makes you jump, for easier ramp boosts. Off in competitive. Turn it off if another tool already does this

autoSpec.name: Auto Spectate
autoSpec.description: Joins public matches as a spectator instead of a player

hsSound.name: Headshot Sound on Every Kill
hsSound.description: Plays the headshot sound on every kill, not just headshots

hpEnemyCounter.name: Hardpoint Enemy Counter
hpEnemyCounter.description: Shows how many enemies are on the point in competitive Hardpoint

showPing.name: Player List Ping
showPing.description: Shows everyone's ping next to their name in the player list

realPing.name: Real Ping™️
realPing.description: Pings the lobby server directly and shows your real latency

matchmaker.name: Matchmaker (F6)
matchmaker.description: F6 joins the lowest ping lobby that matches your filters instead of a random one

exitButton.name: Exit Button
exitButton.description: Adds an Exit button to the menu

menuTimer.name: Menu Timer
menuTimer.description: Shows the match timer while you are in the menu

classicMenu.name: Classic Menu
classicMenu.description: Season 9 menu layout, new buttons and features stay

betterChat.name: Better Chat
betterChat.description: Team and all chat in one view. Press Tab to switch where you send

textSelect.name: Selectable Chat
textSelect.description: Lets you select and copy text from the chat

cleanUI.name: Cleaner Menu
cleanUI.description: Hides banners, ads and other clutter in the menu

hideBundles.name: Hide Bundle Popups
hideBundles.description: Stops store bundle popups from showing up outside the store

hidePopularNow.name: Hide Popular Now
hidePopularNow.description: Hides the Popular Now maps row in the menu

clanColors.name: Show Clan Colors
clanColors.description: Colors the tags of some clans in the player lists

cuteBadge.name: Show Kute Badge
cuteBadge.description: Shows a badge next to other Kute players. This only affects what you see, others still see yours

kuteIcons.name: Use Kute Icons
kuteIcons.description: Kute's own icons for counters, ammo, hitmarker, reticle and scope. Your game settings stay untouched

hudLayout.name: HUD Editor
hudLayout.description: Move, resize and hide parts of the in-game HUD. Opens a private match while you edit

keystrokes.name: Keystrokes
keystrokes.description: Shows your movement keys and mouse in the HUD and lights them up while pressed. Move it with the HUD Editor

spotifyOverlay.name: Spotify Overlay
spotifyOverlay.description: Shows the currently playing Spotify track in the HUD. Move and resize it with the HUD Editor

nukeCounter.name: Nuke Counter
nukeCounter.description: Shows your career nuke total in game. It updates when a match ends

renderStats.name: Present FPS Counter
renderStats.description: The game counter shows how fast your PC runs the game, this adds the frames that reach your screen

motionBlur.name: Motion Blur
motionBlur.description: A slight blur while you turn the camera, the HUD stays sharp. Costs FPS: about 10 % fewer while it blurs

motionBlurStrength.name: Motion Blur Strength
motionBlurStrength.description: How long the trail is when Motion Blur is on

customSky.name: Custom Sky
customSky.description: Your own sky color gradient or image on every map. Applies from the next match

swapper.name: Resource Swapper
swapper.description: Replaces game files like textures and sounds with the files in your swapper folder

customCss.name: Custom CSS
customCss.description: Your own CSS on top of Krunker's, with a live preview while you write it

userscripts.name: Userscripts
userscripts.description: Runs your own scripts. Crankshaft and idkr scripts work too

blocklist.name: URL Blocklist
blocklist.description: Blocks ads and trackers. Open the file to add your own entries

disableCats.name: Disable Cats
disableCats.description: Blocks the cat models in the maps

uncapFps.name: Uncap FPS
uncapFps.description: Removes the FPS cap at your monitor's refresh rate

audioFix.name: Fix Audio Stutters
audioFix.description: For sound that cuts out at high FPS. Moves sounds every 8 ms instead of every sample

angleBackend.name: Graphics Backend (ANGLE)
angleBackend.description: Leave it on Default (D3D11). OpenGL and Vulkan turn off everything the swapchain hook does

colorProfile.name: Color Profile
colorProfile.description: Try sRGB if colors look washed out or too strong

webviewPriority.name: Process Priority
webviewPriority.description: Higher can help a little, but may make your PC less stable

x3dCacheCores.name: Keep Kute on the 3D V-Cache cores
x3dCacheCores.description: Ryzen X3D with two core groups only: steadier frame pacing on the cores with the big cache

throttle.name: CPU Throttling
throttle.description: Slows the game down on purpose (2 = half speed). Only for an unstable game, an FPS limit is usually better

inMenuThrottle.name: CPU Throttling in Menu
inMenuThrottle.description: Same, but only in the menu. It also slows the match that runs behind the menu

clearCache.name: Clear Cache & Storage
clearCache.description: Deletes the cache and local storage. This also resets your game settings
clearCache.buttonAction: if(confirm('Are you sure you want to clear cache and local storage?')) { localStorage.clear(); sessionStorage.clear(); window.chrome.webview.postMessage('clear-cache'); }

hardFlip.name: DXGI Swapchain Hook
hardFlip.description: Present FPS counter and OBS capture. Laptops with two graphics chips may run better without it

laptopPowerBoost.name: Laptop Power Boost
laptopPowerBoost.description: Plugged in laptops only: sets Windows' power mode to Best performance while Kute runs and puts yours back after

patchInputPriority.name: Input at Normal Priority
patchInputPriority.description: Chromium patch: mouse input no longer starves the game's server messages. Off brings back the aim freeze

patchFramePacing.name: Frame Pacing
patchFramePacing.description: Chromium patch: the game runs one frame ahead of the screen instead of flooding it. Off brings back the GPU stutter

patchFrameLimiter.name: Chromium FPS Limiter
patchFrameLimiter.description: Chromium patch: holds the FPS limit inside Chromium with the CPU idle, with or without the hook. Off uses the hook's limiter, or a busy wait without the hook

patchRawInputMovement.name: Raw Input Keeps Movement
patchRawInputMovement.description: Chromium patch: no mouse movement is lost on a click. Off drops a few counts at every shot

patchAudioParamCoalesce.name: Coalesce Audio Automation
patchAudioParamCoalesce.description: Chromium patch: the game's per frame sound updates no longer pile up. Off makes FPS drop over a long match

patchCanvasBufferCache.name: WebGL Buffer Cache
patchCanvasBufferCache.description: Chromium patch: keeps three spare frame buffers instead of one. Off makes some starts land in a slow mode

patchHighQoS.name: Game Process at High QoS
patchHighQoS.description: Chromium patch: Windows may not throttle the game's process to save power. Off leaves that to Windows

showChangelog.name: Show Changelog After Updates
showChangelog.description: Shows what's new after Kute updates

disableOnlineFeatures.name: Disable Kute Online Features
disableOnlineFeatures.description: Nothing is sent to or received from kute.lol. Turns off all Kute badges (yours too) and clan colors

checkUpdates.name: Check For Updates
checkUpdates.description: Looks for a new Kute version when it starts

exportClientSettings.name: Export Kute Settings
exportClientSettings.description: Saves Kute's settings, HUD positions, matchmaker filters and hotkeys as a file in Downloads

importClientSettings.name: Import Kute Settings
importClientSettings.description: Loads a file from Export Kute Settings and restarts Kute
